newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares index closes off record set earlier.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares index closes off record set earlier.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 22-share index closed on Monday above 500 for the first time at 504.55 but off the record 507.75 set at 1300 GMT. It was 495.57 on Friday.
* Reported market volume was a healthy $90 million.
* Mosenergo utility was the most traded share and fell to under $1.60 in after-hours trading from a daily high of about $1.700 and from Friday's $1.640 close on $27 million turnover.
* UES national electric utility ticked down to $0.4610 from $0.4620 on $20 million turnover.
* Truck maker Kamaz was among the top price losers, falling to $2.17 from $2.31.
* Prefs of metals group Norilsk Nickel were among top gainers, closing at $7.60 after $7.00.
